notes: Right-click a warehouse part to Edit quantity with a reason (direct sale, received, adjusted, scrap) — the change logs to the Activity feed. Add a note to any part (what it's actually for): keep it private to your desk or share it so every tech sees it on the part. A chime plays when a new notification arrives. Tech part requests now show their note on the check-out sheet, and CSV refreshes no longer wipe shared notes.
